final:
parity(x: int) -> int =
  post out == 0 or out == 1
  ex parity(2) == 0
  ex parity(3) == 1
  x % 2

parities(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex parities([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [1, 0, 1, 0]
  let ys = par for x in xs
    parity(x)
  ys
